hero.sede: Panda Troupe, Olivera, Buenos Aires, Argentina

parrafos: For the first time, Argentina is hosting the Latin American Bowhunter Championship. From December 5th to 8th, archers from across the region will gather at Panda Troupe, a former quarry turned woodland: uneven ground, shadows, demanding angles, and silhouettes cutting through the trees.

Four days of competition under IFAA rules, where good aim alone isn't enough. You have to read the terrain, judge every distance, and trust your instinct. A course designed to challenge the best 3D archers in Latin America in a uniquely natural setting.
But LABHC is also a gathering. Four days to bring the community together, share an asado, swap experiences with archers from different countries, and celebrate a discipline that keeps on growing.
Whatever your 3D background, your bow has a place here. We'll be waiting for you in the woods, from December 5th to 8th.

bloque1.titulo: The union of Flechar and Liga 3D Metropolitana
parrafos: Liga 3D Metropolitana and Club Flechar were born from the same place: a passion for 3D archery and the drive to help it grow. Over four consecutive years, L3DM established itself by organizing the country's best 3D tournaments, bringing together a community of hundreds of archers of every level, awarding millions of pesos in prizes, and setting up Argentina's best 3D targets on the range.

Flechar, an archery school with more than two decades of experience, brings the pillar that any top-level competition needs: technical knowledge. Its IFAA international instructor certification and its experience training archers add the sporting rigor, teaching, and command of the rulebook that make the difference.

Joining these two forces wasn't a coincidence — it was the natural conclusion of two institutions that share the same vision: that Argentine 3D archery deserves to stand alongside the best in the world.

That union gave rise to the most ambitious challenge the community has ever taken on: organizing, for the first time in Argentina, the Latin American Bowhunter Championship. This isn't just a tournament — it's the most important 3D event in Argentine history: a chance to put the country on the continental map of the discipline, and to show, both at home and abroad, everything we're capable of building when we work together.
It's a big bet, with little time and a lot to do, but taken on with the conviction that we're writing a page Argentine 3D archery will remember.

bloque2.texto: The IFAA organizes the world championships and sanctions the annual championships of its six regions, one of which is Latin America. The Latin American Bowhunter Championship is precisely that: our region's championship — having the IFAA's endorsement is what gives this tournament its official, Latin American standing.
